bitcoin_articles.headline: PowerCompute, Inc. Announces Preliminary Bitcoin Mining and Operating Results for October 2026
bitcoin_articles.summary: PowerCompute, Inc. reported mining approximately 9.0 Bitcoin in October 2026, representing a 20% increase year-over-year and an 11.1% increase from the previous month.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Falconedge plc Reports October Bitcoin Yield Results
bitcoin_articles.summary: Falconedge plc announced its October performance for its Bitcoin Yield Strategy, reporting a monthly yield of 0.379% and an increase in total holdings to 21.6425 BTC.
